subject: Aurora AI — Dedicated capacity: decision log & onboarding next steps
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@auroraai.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: daniel.kovacs@auroraai.com, procurement@auroraai.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity kickoff — Aurora model fleet needs and timeline

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the fast responses during last week's demo. We're ready to start planning the Dedicated capacity engagement for our multi-model serving fleet (inference-heavy recommendation + reranking). High level asks:

- Predictable tail latency <= 120ms p95 for our 2k qps baseline.
- Autoscale + burst for theatrical peaks (Black Friday-style traffic) up to 6x baseline for short bursts.
- Regional preference: primary in us-west with eu fallback; we may later enable ap-southeast.

Can you share a short decision log and your recommended sizing / autoscale profile we can use to fast-track procurement? Procurement cc'd for contractual timing. Looking to aim for a Nov 30 activation window.

Appreciate it —
Sarah
Sarah Li
VP, Platform — Aurora AI
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@auroraai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, daniel.kovacs@auroraai.com, procurement@auroraai.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity kickoff — Aurora model fleet needs and timeline

Hi Sarah —

Great, thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass decision log (activation-decision-log-aurora.md) plus a draft sizing workbook (aurora_dedicated_capacity_draft.xlsx). High-level recommendations now so procurement has numbers:

- Initial reserved pool: 16 A100-equivalent GPUs (estimate covers 2k sustained qps with margin).
- Autoscale policy: target CPU/GPU utilization triggers with gradual scale steps: +4 GPUs every 2 minutes, up to 3x sustained.
- Burst window: a separate short-burst pool configured for instant-add (warm standby) to cover up to 6x baseline for traffic spikes up to 20 minutes. Billing model: blend of reserved + burst usage; we'll include projected cost curves in the workbook.
- Region: us-west primary; eu-west hot standby for traffic shaping and GDPR-sensitive flows. We recommend deferring ap-southeast until month+1 to avoid regional activation complexity on first turn-up.

Next actions I propose:
1) Internal ops sizing confirmation (Karthik) — confirm GPU type & burst mechanism.
2) CS activation checklist (Monica) — runbook items, test prompts, KB for Aurora SREs.
3) Procurement milestone (Aurora) — finalize MA/contract by Nov 26 for Nov 30 target.

I'll follow up with a short internal note for ops.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Implementation Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity kickoff — Aurora model fleet needs and timeline

Tessa,

Reviewed the workbook — thanks. A few ops notes / clarifying questions:

- GPU type: A100-40GB (preferred) or L7x (if cost dictates, we'll present quantized pathway). We can support mixed pools for canarying.
- Autoscale: +4 GPUs every 2m is fine, but burst fallback should be configured as pre-warmed nodes (warm standby) rather than cold start to meet the 20 minute short-burst requirement. Warm standby costs ~10% of on-demand for reservation.
- Networking: us-west primary should be deployed across two AZs for AZ-level failure tolerance; eu-west will be cold-standby with cache-warmed replicas for GDPR pathing.

I'll prepare a minimal ops runbook snippet for the activation checklist and attach to this thread. Two risk items: longer-than-expected cache-warm times (models with large KV cache) and quota limits in eu region — both flagged.

—Karthik
Lead, Serving Operations
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: sarah.li@auroraai.com, daniel.kovacs@auroraai.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity kickoff — Aurora model fleet needs and timeline

Adding CS perspective and test plan items:

- Activation smoke tests: latency sweep (p50/p95), throughput ramp (0 -> 2k qps -> 6x bursts), degradation behavior checks, and fallback correctness (eu route).
- Prompts/test prompts: we'll need 3 canonical prompt sets per model for regression checks and 1 long-context stress prompt for KV cache validation.
- Rollout plan: Canary on 5% traffic (mixed pool) -> 25% after 2 hours -> full routing after 24hr stable metrics. We should automate canary rollback policy based on p95 and error spikes.

I've uploaded a draft test manifest to the shared drive (link in related_links). Will coordinate with Aurora SREs for a mid-day test on Nov 30 if procurement clears the timeline.

—Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:58:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity kickoff — Aurora model fleet needs and timeline

Looping in a quick governance note — Tessa / Monica / Karthik:

- Approve the reserve/burst plan as-is for the Nov 30 activation window and I'll expedite the finance approval for a 3-month initial term with the standard Dedicated pricing bands.
- Please confirm the reserve count (16) or propose a +/− delta before EOD Nov 29.

If ops flags quota or a major risk, we can shift to a staggered activation (us-west first, eu second) and still keep Nov 30 for us-west.

—Rishi
VP, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@auroraai.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity kickoff — Aurora model fleet needs and timeline

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the decision log. Procurement has signaled that the contract will be ready on Nov 29 and they will wire the initial payment the same day. We confirm the initial reserved count at 18 GPUs (we're adding +2 for margin based on our internal load tests). Please treat eu-west as hot standby but not active routing until we do a second-day validation.

Nov 30 schedule: 10:00 PT activation smoke window, 14:00 PT canary ramp to 25%. SREs will be on the call.

See you tomorrow.

—Sarah
VP, Platform — Aurora AI
